'''Spell of the Seven Oaths''' was a spell capable of protecting individuals from certain threats. After the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Vulgarr/Legends|Vulgarr]] kidnapped the [[Wokling/Legends|woklings]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] warned him that the spell couldn't protect him from the wraith of the [[Great Spirit]].
